subject.title: feat(agents): Swarm core — collector spawn, agents_wait, structured output, caps (gated)

question: Should OpenClaw accept this gated, persistent core Swarm v1 contract now, or keep the program direction in the canonical proposal until its core scope and Codex projection contract are explicitly sponsored?
rationale: The patch adds a new core orchestration mode, durable registry state, protocol fields, and public configuration rather than repairing established behavior; its large surface cannot be accepted solely from implementation quality.

options.title: Sponsor the bounded core v1
options.body: Approve the gated collector, wait, cap, and persistence contract after the hot-path fallback is repaired and upgrade proof is supplied.

options.title: Narrow before acceptance
options.body: Keep the canonical program open and split or defer persistence/projection portions until the permanent core boundary is agreed.

options.title: Defer the core direction
options.body: Pause this implementation while the orchestration capability is reconsidered as a later product milestone.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the bounded core v1
recommendation.body: Approve the gated collector, wait, cap, and persistence contract after the hot-path fallback is repaired and upgrade proof is supplied.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked proposal and current implementation series identify steipete as the best available routing candidate for the Swarm v1 scope decision.
